contents.text: Settings -> Skin Customization -> Main Hand: Left

Main Hand: Left = gun RIGHT, knife LEFT.
Main Hand: Right = gun LEFT, knife RIGHT.

Change this in Minecraft settings yourself; this menu cannot change it. Then select the matching HUD and effect alignment below. The choice is saved for you only. If you change Main Hand again, update this choice too.

Left-click knives. Right-click shoots. F switches weapons.

actions.label: HUD + Effects: Gun on Right
actions.tooltip: Choose after setting Main Hand to Left. Aligns your HUD and muzzle smoke; does not change Minecraft settings.

actions.label: HUD + Effects: Gun on Left
actions.tooltip: Choose after setting Main Hand to Right. Aligns your HUD and muzzle smoke; does not change Minecraft settings.
